answer: Sybil Defenses via Resource Scarcity. The Wrench Mechanism. Each new agent must extract one walnut from a finite grove, carry it across a shifting dune, then secure it at a specific wharf node. The grove yields only one walnut per season, making each identity require irreplaceable time and physical presence. Clone creation forces attackers to duplicate extraction, transport, and anchoring—costing them weeks of effort with zero resale value. Marginal clones become strictly negative-EV because the resource cannot be rapidly replicated or transferred.
